svg.title: HTL-ReID overall architecture
svg.desc: RGB, NIR, and TIR images pass through a shared ViT backbone. Hierarchical Selection combines attention rollout and a frequency mask. Adaptive Cross-modal Interaction uses complete backbone tokens under the HS mask, Part-aware Local Representation pools HS-selected patches, and Dynamic Heterogeneous Fusion independently processes seven full-token routes. Four normalized descriptors are weighted and concatenated.
svg.text: HTL-ReID: Hierarchical Token Learning for RGB-NIR-TIR Re-Identification
Shared encoding, mask-guided interaction, local representation, and independent heterogeneous fusion

g.text: rollout mask OR frequency mask = complete HS selection
Each target CLS attends to both other modalities
seven parallel routes from complete backbone tokens
All module labels are paper-facing names.
